transcript: -Ready? -All right, Lewis, you're on. -Lewis, good luck. You're on your own, buddy. -All right. (grunting) You're looking good, Lewis! Welcome to Survivor Exile Island. I start off, and I'm whipping. I'm just, like, "Keep going, keep whacking that pole." (grunting) Ooh! It feels impossible, but there's that adventurous kid inside of me that's like, "Go for it." Oh, God. Oh, no. I need that idol, and I'm so determined. I've exerted all of my force... ...to chop, chop, chop. And then, at a certain point... Oh, God. Oh. ...I'm physically just reeling. My hands are in bits. My hands are destroyed. I beat and bruised and bloodied myself, but do you know what? Irish people-- we are troupers. (panting) Come on. (exhales) At this point, I'm just going 110%. And honestly, it's just torture. Oh, my God. Oh, no. Please, please, please, please, please. (mutters) (panting): Come on. Come on. No, no, no, no, no, no, no. (grunting loudly) I mean, it's just like a knife to the heart. Tonight's gonna be a long night.
